text:
with ternuras of mother and piedades of hermana

me ofreciste a oasis of peace in esta war,

por eso al alejarse the errante caravana,

your memory in the fondo of the heart encierra;


and with él the tristezas of his autumn engalana…

Pupila that the death without mirarte itself cierra

no sabrá what is belleza, because you eres, Habana,

the ciudad more beautiful that floreció in the earth.


¡in my farewell, as ofrenda, you dejo the soul mía!…

¡that the dioses you amparen, ciudad of encantamiento,

and that always contemple the pupila viajera


over the maravilloso cristal of your bahía

fulgurar ondulante a the gloria of the wind

the star solitaria that brilla in your bandera!…

translation.title: farewell a Cuba
